sections.title: About SEO House
sections.text: Since 2017, we've helped companies improve their search visibility with a clear plan and results we review together.

sections.title: Meet our team
sections.text: SEO doesn't work in isolation. Our team brings together search, content, development and performance analysis, so work moves from recommendation to implementation on the site itself.

items.text: The beginning: a company specializing in search engine optimization.
SEO is our core specialty, alongside website and online store design and development, and product uploading, each offered as a standalone service.
We serve companies in Saudi Arabia, Egypt and the UAE, and we work with Saudi and Emirati companies remotely.

sections.title: Four principles that guide every project

items.heading: We start with data, not a ready-made checklist
items.text: We study the site's current state and how its customers search before we propose any work.

items.heading: We implement, not just recommend
items.text: A recommendation that isn't implemented doesn't change results. We implement on the site or work alongside your team.

items.heading: We measure what matters to the business
items.text: Traffic is an intermediate metric. What we track is inquiries, orders and revenue.

items.heading: We tell you what we can't do
items.text: If a goal is unrealistic or the timeline isn't enough, we say so before we agree, not after.

sections.title: Clear boundaries before we start

items.label: We don't promise a specific position in search results or a guaranteed timeframe.
We don't show any result we can't prove from the client's account.
We don't publish a client's name or data without their consent.
We don't use link sources or tactics that violate search engine guidelines.

sections.heading: How we present results
sections.text: We show every result with its source and time period exactly as they appear in the client's account, and we name the client only with their consent.
